AI · Card 5 Card 5: Media
The role of television has changed considerably since I was a child. There were only a few channels and the whole family would watch the same programme together. Nowadays, everyone watches what they want on their own device. Some people think that this has weakened family life, whereas others are pleased to have more choice. I personally miss the shared experience. If we had kept those habits, families would perhaps communicate more. However, I admit that I too spend hours watching series on my laptop. I sometimes wonder whether we have gained as much as we think from all this freedom of choice.

🖨️ Print:
1.Thanks to the foundation press freedom French law freedom of the press is a pillar of democracy
 
2.The controversial 2020 French law against hate speech strives to combat hate speech
 
3.The protest movement sparked online in 2018 that showed the power of social media mobilization threatened to occupy roundabouts.
 
4.It seems that they spend time broaching individuals’ personal lives
 
5.We must teach parents to activate the parental control on their children’s devices.
 
6.We talk less and less about the Charlie Hebdo terrorist attack, a tragic event.
 
7.More and more journalists face threats, as the terrorist attack targeting journalists at a satirical magazine shows.
 
8.I have resolved to read the satirical weekly newspaper known for investigative journalism more often with the result that I am able to explain political scandals to my pupils
 
9.The French media watchdog up to 2022 monitors online content
 
10.I am not surprised that some newspapers have successfully transitioned to digital.
 
11.Today, social media serve as major sources of information for many young people.
 
12.Compared to the British press, in France public interest focuses less on the private lives of celebrities
 
13.Digital newspapers like Mediapart are a threat to print newspapers.
 
14.In order to protect public order, we must toughen sanctions against those who take part in violent protests.
 
15.We suspect that media have played a key role during election periods.
 
16.The Yellow Vests used platforms to protest in 2018.
 
17.Since France Soir ceased the publication of its print edition in 2011, its journalists have had direct interactions with readers.
 
18.Entertainment programmes like the popular French reality TV show based on survival challenges, similar to Survivor face competition from streaming platforms.
 
19.The major centre-right French daily newspaper, founded in the 19th century offers digital subscriptions while still maintaining a limited print readership.
 
20.The filtering of inappropriate content is essential to the protection of under 18s.
 
21.We cannot grow tired of social media, which have become a must-have means of communication.
 
22.People have a right to privacy and are protected by certain laws including the French legal article guaranteeing privacy
 
23.It is rare that the press is forced to denounce abuses of power
 
24.I think that the French version of Come dine with me and the French version of the Bake Off are entertaining programmes.
 
25.Journalistic investigations make it possible to guarantee transparency in political affairs
 
26.The role of the CSA was to regulate audio-visual content.
 
27.He remarked that online content should sometimes be censored
 
28.French people were deeply shocked by the media scandal involving a presidential aide caught on video assaulting protesters
 
29.TF1 et France 2 devraient produire plus de contenus originaux
 
30.Publishing caricatures of the Prophet Muhammad is considered blasphemous by some Muslims.
 
31.For an influencer, advertisement constitutes the majority of his revenue.
 
32.Young people are constantly exposed to inappropriate content online such as violent or pornographic images.
 
33.Series are gaining ground in young people’s lives.
 
34.Streaming appeals with its global catalogue and flexibility: it meets the needs of the public.
 
35.The government swears to strengthen the fight against cyber hate thanks to awareness campaigns.
 
Answer Key
#🇬🇧 English🇫🇷 French (answer)
1Thanks to the foundation press freedom French law freedom of the press is a pillar of democracyGrâce à la loi du 29 juillet de 1881 la liberté de la presse est un pilier de la démocratie
2The controversial 2020 French law against hate speech strives to combat hate speechLa loi Avia de 2020 s'efforce de lutter contre les discours de haine
3The protest movement sparked online in 2018 that showed the power of social media mobilization threatened to occupy roundabouts.Les Gilets Jaunes ont menacé d’occuper les ronds-points.
4It seems that they spend time broaching individuals’ personal livesIl semble qu’ils passent du temps à aborder la vie personnelle des individus
5We must teach parents to activate the parental control on their children’s devices.Nous devons apprendre aux parents à activer le contrôle parental sur les appareils de leurs enfants.
6We talk less and less about the Charlie Hebdo terrorist attack, a tragic event.Nous parlons de moins en moins de l’attentat de Charlie Hebdo, un événement tragique.
7More and more journalists face threats, as the terrorist attack targeting journalists at a satirical magazine shows.De plus en plus de journalistes font face à des menaces, comme le montre l’attentat de Charlie Hebdo de 2015.
8I have resolved to read the satirical weekly newspaper known for investigative journalism more often with the result that I am able to explain political scandals to my pupilsJ'ai résolu de lire plus souvent le Canard Enchaîné de sorte que je sais expliquer les scandales politiques à mes élèves
9The French media watchdog up to 2022 monitors online contentLe CSA surveille les contenus en ligne
10I am not surprised that some newspapers have successfully transitioned to digital.Ça ne m’étonne pas que certains journaux aient réussi sa transition numérique
11Today, social media serve as major sources of information for many young people.Les réseaux sociaux servent aujourd’hui de sources d’informations pour beaucoup de jeunes.
12Compared to the British press, in France public interest focuses less on the private lives of celebritiesPar rapport à la presse britannique, en France l’intérêt du public se porte moins sur la vie privée des célébrités
13Digital newspapers like Mediapart are a threat to print newspapers.Les journaux numériques comme Médiapart sont une menace aux journaux imprimés.
14In order to protect public order, we must toughen sanctions against those who take part in violent protests.Afin de protéger l’ordre public, nous devons renforcer les sanctions contre ceux qui participent à des manifestations violentes.
15We suspect that media have played a key role during election periods.Nous soupçonnons que les médias aient joué un rôle clé pendant des périodes électorales.
16The Yellow Vests used platforms to protest in 2018.Les Gilets Jaunes ont utilisé les plateformes pour manifester en 2018.
17Since France Soir ceased the publication of its print edition in 2011, its journalists have had direct interactions with readers.Depuis que France Soir a cessé sa version papier en 2011, ses journalistes ont une interaction directe avec les lecteurs.
18Entertainment programmes like the popular French reality TV show based on survival challenges, similar to Survivor face competition from streaming platforms.Les émissions de divertissement comme Koh-Lanta subissent la concurrence des plateformes de streaming.
19The major centre-right French daily newspaper, founded in the 19th century offers digital subscriptions while still maintaining a limited print readership.Le Figaro propose des abonnements numériques tout en conservant un lectorat papier limité
20The filtering of inappropriate content is essential to the protection of under 18s.Le filtrage des contenus inappropriés est essentiel à la protection des mineurs.
21We cannot grow tired of social media, which have become a must-have means of communication.On ne peut pas se lasser des réseaux sociaux, qui sont devenus un moyen de communication incontournable.
22People have a right to privacy and are protected by certain laws including the French legal article guaranteeing privacyLes gens ont droit à une vie privée et sont protégés par certaines lois, y compris l’article 9 du Code Civil
23It is rare that the press is forced to denounce abuses of powerIl est rare que la presse soit contrainte de dénoncer des abus de pouvoir
24I think that the French version of Come dine with me and the French version of the Bake Off are entertaining programmes.Je pense qu’ Un dîner presque parfait et que Le meilleur pâtissier sont des programmes divertissants.
25Journalistic investigations make it possible to guarantee transparency in political affairsLes enquêtes journalistiques permettent de garantir la transparence dans les affaires politiques
26The role of the CSA was to regulate audio-visual content.Le rôle du CSA était de réguler le contenu audio-visuel en France.
27He remarked that online content should sometimes be censoredIl a fait remarquer que les contenus en ligne devraient parfois être censurés
28French people were deeply shocked by the media scandal involving a presidential aide caught on video assaulting protestersLes Français ont été profondément choqués par l’affaire Benalla.
29TF1 et France 2 devraient produire plus de contenus originauxFrance’s main private TV channel, known for popular entertainment shows and news and the main public television channel in France, part of the France Télévisions group should produce more original content.
30Publishing caricatures of the Prophet Muhammad is considered blasphemous by some Muslims.Publier des caricatures du prophète Mahomet est considéré comme blasphématoire par certains musulmans.
31For an influencer, advertisement constitutes the majority of his revenue.Pour un influenceur, la publicité constitue la majorité de ses revenus
32Young people are constantly exposed to inappropriate content online such as violent or pornographic images.Les jeunes sont constamment exposés à des contenus inappropriés en ligne tels que des images violentes ou pornographiques.
33Series are gaining ground in young people’s lives.Les séries prennent une place croissante dans la vie des jeunes.
34Streaming appeals with its global catalogue and flexibility: it meets the needs of the public.Le streaming séduit par son catalogue mondial et sa flexibilité : il répond aux besoins du public.
35The government swears to strengthen the fight against cyber hate thanks to awareness campaigns.Le gouvernement jure de renforcer la lutte contre la cyberhaine grâce à des campagnes de sensibilisation.
